procedure: transient_convergence_procedure_v7 (A9.31 sec. 5 estimator per stratum): S: e = (|x_N - x_T2| + |x_T1 - x_T2|) / s_F per implementation, bound E_py^S + E_rust^S; U: E_rust^U (Rust estimator) + D_py^U (max |x_T1 - x_T2| / s_F of the Python reference) over leaves whose reference is convergent (rho < 1/2); no multiplier

PROD.rust_method: Radau IIA order 5 (DIV-P-01; v4 switching-point fix, v6 growing-mode guard)
PROD.vectors: P42 / P43 PROD vectors (module defaults) and every P45 vector

REF.rust_method: Radau IIA order 5 (DIV-P-01; v4 switching-point fix, v6 growing-mode guard)
REF.vectors: P42 / P43 REF vectors (rtol RTOL_REFERENCE, method INTEGRATOR_REFERENCE)

tolerance_levels.rule: a tightened run changes rtol only: same implementation and method, same atol (ATOL_SCALED 1e-11 on the scaled states), same t_eval sample grid, same event sequence and inputs

override_mechanics.python: P42 / P43: the rtol / method arguments of TransientRun / transient_case; P45: orbit_simulated has no rtol argument, so the harness sets the default rtol of TransientRun.__init__ in its own process for the tightened P45 runs only (no reference file is changed; the nominal P45 runs use the unmodified default)
override_mechanics.rust: P42 / P43: the request 'rtol'; P45: a request carrying 'rtol' is evaluated by the parity CLI as TransientRun::new(rtol) + steady_start + run + the orbit_simulated record (library calls only); check COMP-P-01: at the nominal rtol this composed path equals the library orbit_simulated byte for byte on every P45 refinement vector (recorded in the envelope record; a mismatch voids the record)

closing_valve_xO (reported, not scored).known_property: converged cross-implementation disagreement of an ill-posed observable (the sign of a rounding-level valve opening decides which samples have a defined xO); not resolved by choosing one value; v6 grid instance R43-REF-809 segment 6 xO_min: Rust 0.51716, Python 0.51607 (refinement_v6_p4243_note.md)
